# Trading Direkt 2026-10-27 | Olavi om sentimentet och Tobbe med TA

**Feed**: trading-direkt  
**Published**: 2026-10-27  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Guest Jonas Olavi (Alcur/Alpcot fund manager) argues that investors are more fearful than company fundamentals justify. He sees a Goldilocks economy, reads extreme Fear & Greed readings as a buy signal, and sees the oversold semiconductor index (RSI ~30, P/E almost halved to 16.8) as a buying opportunity, with Nvidia his top pick and memory names such as Micron central to the AI bottleneck. Technical analyst Tobbe Rosén is still positive on OMXS30 and expects a seasonal year-end rally, but his single-stock views are mostly negative or neutral (Volvo, SSAB, Munters, SBB, Gapwaves, Boliden). His exceptions are Handelsbanken, Kinnevik and Nvidia, where he is positive.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Olavi's top pick among Nvidia/AMD/Broadcom; freed TSMC 3nm capacity; Rosén also positive technically.

#### Reasoning

Guest says GPU demand is brutal and that Apple moving to 2nm frees TSMC 3nm capacity for Nvidia, so he expects fantastic growth this autumn. The semiconductor index looks oversold (RSI ~30, bounce at MA200) and its P/E has fallen to 16.8 while earnings estimates keep rising. Host TA Rosén reads Nvidia's chart as still positive at its rising support line.

#### Sell Triggers

- central banks hike aggressively and puncture the cycle
- Nvidia breaks rising support line before taking out the short-term top (new lower highs)
- AI capex slowdown from hyperscalers

> *"Alla tre, men om jag måste välja en så tar jag en Nvidia."*

---

### 🟢 MU — Micron | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Olavi prefers Micron over SK Hynix; HBM memory is the central AI bottleneck with prices possibly doubling.

#### Reasoning

Three companies dominate HBM, and that capacity cannot be expanded quickly. Demand will persist as models reason more, and prices are rising sharply. Olavi holds or watches the memory names and picks Micron over SK Hynix, though he admits the choice was hard. One risk is that very high memory prices could hurt end demand next year.

#### Sell Triggers

- memory price spikes start damaging demand next year
- HBM capacity expansion faster than expected

> *"Den är rätt svår. Micron skulle jag ändå säga."*

---

### 🟢 SHB-A — Handelsbanken | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Rosén: oversold, negative momentum waning, buy signal close in MACD; positive and expects further gains.

#### Reasoning

The stock has pulled back to the floor of an adjusted rising channel. It is slightly oversold, negative momentum has eased, and a Stochastic MACD buy signal is near. Filling the gap with a strong close would give good odds of a move higher. Rosén says several other banks also look interesting.

#### Sell Triggers

- price breaks below rising channel floor
- gap not passed with strong close

> *"Så jag är positiv till Handelsbanken och tror på fortsatta uppgångar."*

---

### 🟢 KINV-B — Kinnevik | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Rosén: above FIB50 and MA200, higher low; stretched with negative divergence, but next sell pressure likely buyable.

#### Reasoning

Price has moved above FIB50 of the latest swing and is wrestling with FIB62. MA200 has been respected and a new higher low has formed, so the chart has improved over the past half year. It is stretched above the channel top with a negative divergence, so a pullback is likely, but Rosén expects buyers to absorb it. The long-term downtrend is not yet broken.

#### Sell Triggers

- falls back below standard line and FIB50
- fails to hold MA200
- no higher low after pullback

> *"jag är positiv till aktien. Och tror att det är ganska goda förutsättningar för att köparna kommer suga upp nästa säljtryck och att det blir köpvärt."*

---

### 🟠 HMS — HMS Networks | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Testing MA200; Rosén neutral to emerging weakly positive; passing gap with strong close would be bullish.

#### Reasoning

The stock fell back to test the 200-day moving average. If the gap is passed with a strong close, price could rise toward the high of the long red candle. Until then Rosén is neutral, leaning weakly positive.

#### Sell Triggers

- MA200 breaks without quick recapture

> *"Neutral till begynnande svagt positiv är HMS Networks."*

---

### ⛔ VOLV-B — Volvo | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Rosén: series of lower highs, sellers dominate short-term picture; negative.

#### Reasoning

After its top, Volvo has made progressively lower highs and has failed to take out short-term tops on bounces. There is only a slight positive divergence in the Stochastic MACD, so Rosén stays negative.

#### Sell Triggers

- price takes out latest short-term top without a new lower low

> *"det är fortfarande säljarna som dominerar det kortsiktiga bilden tycker jag, så jag är negativ även till Volvo."*

---

### ⛔ SSAB-A — SSAB | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Big rise into resistance, broken support now resistance, MACD negative, report tomorrow.

#### Reasoning

After a strong run-up, SSAB has stalled at resistance. Its former rising support line now acts as resistance and the Stochastic MACD is in negative territory. Rosén sees more pointing to a decline ahead of tomorrow's report.

#### Sell Triggers

- strong report breaks price above resistance

> *"Och det är mer tycker jag som tyder på nedgång nu än uppgång."*

---

### ⛔ MTRS — Munters | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Medium-term falling channel, all MAs pointing down, MACD negative; Rosén negative.

#### Reasoning

After its prior uptrend, Munters now trades in a medium-term falling trend channel with every moving average pointing down. Rosén wants a break above MA50, prior tops or the gap without a new lower low before changing his view.

#### Sell Triggers

- break above MA50/gap without new lower low

> *"Så jag är för tillfället negativ till Muntos."*

---

### ⛔ SBB-B — SBB Norden | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Falling trend of lower highs; bounces are pause formations; no sign of positive change.

#### Reasoning

SBB has made consistently lower significant tops. Stochastic MACD is below zero and volume balance is negative. Rosén calls rebounds pause formations within the decline and sees no hint of a higher low. Oversold conditions could cause sharp bounces, but they do not change the trend.

#### Sell Triggers

- price closes above short-term top followed by higher low
- Stochastic MACD crosses above zero with positive volume balance

> *"det är mer som talar för ned en uppgång"*

---

### ⛔ GAPW-B — Gapwaves | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lowest since 2017, all supports broken; Rosén negative, less hopeful than before.

#### Reasoning

The stock has fallen to levels last seen in 2017 and all of its support levels are broken. Rosén is less positive than he was previously. A strong close above the doji and into the gap could trigger a move to fill the gap, but for now he expects further decline.

#### Sell Triggers

- price breaks above doji and closes strongly inside the gap

> *"För tillfället så är jag negativ till aktien"*

---

### ⛔ BOL — Boliden | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Range-bound below all MAs, MACD negative; weakly negative, at most a tiny watch position.

#### Reasoning

Boliden is stuck in a range, below its short and long moving averages, with Stochastic MACD below zero. Rosén expects choppy moves. Anyone who wants a position should keep it very small and wait for resistance levels to be taken out and held.

#### Sell Triggers

- resistance levels taken out and held

> *"för tillfället så är jag nog lite svagt negativ och beredd på att det kan bli fortsatt stökigt i Boliden."*

---

### ⛔ STE-R — Stora Enso | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Lower top, range-bound, choppy; weakly negative until 140 passed.

#### Reasoning

The stock has fallen back after a lower top and trades in a range where choppy moves are likely. Rosén wants the short-term top at 140 to be passed without a new lower low.

#### Sell Triggers

- 140 level passed without new lower low

> *"Jag är för tillfället svagt negativ till Stora Enso"*

---

### ⛔ MMGR-B — Momentum Group | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Around falling MA200; most MAs slope down; neutral to weakly negative.

#### Reasoning

Despite a golden cross and a positive Stochastic MACD cross, MA200, MA50 and MA20 all slope down and the MACD is in negative territory. Rosén says passing 132 followed by higher lows could start an upmove.

#### Sell Triggers

- price passes 132 standard line with new higher lows

> *"jag är någonstans mellan neutral och svagt negativ"*

---

### ⛔ NEXAM — Nexam Chemical | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

At support with slight respect, MACD below zero; negative pending strong closes on rising volume.

#### Reasoning

The stock has fallen back to a support area and shows only slight respect there on low volume. Stochastic MACD is below zero. Rosén wants strong closes on rising volume followed by follow-through bars.

#### Sell Triggers

- strong closes on rising volume with follow-through

> *"Så för tillfället negativ till Nexam Chemical Holding."*

---

### 🟠 ATCO-A — Atlas Copco | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Very oversold, %B short-term buy signal and green marubozu, but trend still down; weakly negative with bounce edge.

#### Reasoning

After a negative reaction to its report, the stock sits at support with the gap holding. It is very oversold and %B has triggered a short-term buy signal confirmed by a strong green marubozu. The short-term direction is still down, so Rosén is weakly negative. Passing 194-195 would open 214-215.

#### Sell Triggers

- fails at 194-195 standard line and falls back
- gap support breaks

> *"Så jag är lite svagt negativ till aktien. Men å andra sidan så är det en bra edge för en uppstuds härifrån."*
